turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric (and cannot filter to weekend or weekday days), so I cannot give a per-day average; the closest metric is Revenue (EUR), which from 17 August to 27 September 2026 totalled, by ISO weekday, EUR 2,340.75 on Mondays, EUR 2,301.25 on Tuesdays, EUR 2,329.25 on Wednesdays, EUR 2,383.25 on Thursdays, EUR 2,221.75 on Fridays, EUR 2,252.75 on Saturdays and EUR 2,423.75 on Sundays. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
